items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: license-check might core dump on MX routers
items.description: An intermittent license check daemon core dump might happen. The license service will auto restart and recover.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: On Junos platforms MPLS resolving over IPV6 route traffic drop is seen
items.description: On Junos platforms error messages seen with traffic drops on labelled route present in mpls.0 resolving over a IPV6 prefix.

items.synopsis: Test Configuration might fail even though the config file is having valid configurations
items.description: Root cause; In test configuration flow we are calling mustd as "/usr/sbin/mustd -q /var/run/db/file.data /var/run/db/file.data+ -F -m" where we just copy the existing cog.db (generated out of committed config) as cdg.db+ , use it for testing the configuration passed, and remove it once the testing is done. This is creating the issue because the configuration is tested against the existing cdg.db. Fix would be to create the cdg.db fresh from the configuration to be tested and test the configuration against that. This new cdg.db should not replace the existing one in /var/run/db.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present
items.description: On SRX platforms, configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process might crash during commit synchronize
items.description: On all Junos OS and Evolved OS platforms with dual RE (Routing Engine) during commit script synchronize, backup RE mgd get crash once the memory leak reaches to 65K due to which commit configuration will fail which are performed through Master RE.

items.synopsis: The commit changes will not take effect post software upgrade once the system is rebooted on Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved Platforms, any UI (user interface) set (configuration, script, license) changes done post software addition were being lost after the subsequent reboot.

items.synopsis: Lo0 filter change might trigger parity error, when filter is changed from ISF to Non ISF or vice versa
items.description: Lo0 filter change might trigger parity error, when filter is changed from ISF to Non ISF or vice versa

items.synopsis: Picd coredump is seen on Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: On Junos Evolved platforms, Picd coredump is seen when the netconf notification is enabled with the config system services netconf notification. This config should be disabled to avoid this picd core.

items.synopsis: 400G DAC link not coming up Broadcom shell shows as speed as 12.4G instead of 400g
items.description: The links are not coming up between two TD4 devices when Auto-negotiation is enabled for DAC cables. We are following up on this issue with the vendor(BCM). Available Work-around for this issue is to configure the below-set cli command on both sides of the links. set interfaces ether-options no-auto-negotiation Thanks.
